description: A large crowd of workers climbs a broad flight of stone steps on a rocky, excavated slope, carrying blocks on their heads. Above them stands a big mosque in red and cream stone with a tall pointed-arch gateway, several onion domes, minarets and scaffolding. Smoke rises into a hazy sunset sky, and a red-walled fort with towers sits in the distance at left. The scene is an oil-painting style, with no visible text, frame or border.
